# Huecode

> Huecode is a free, open-source color palette generator. It turns a text description or an image into an accessible Tailwind CSS palette, with WCAG contrast checks, a live UI preview and code export.

## What it does

- Generates a palette from a text prompt (mood, brand, theme) or an uploaded image
- Builds full Tailwind-style shade scales (50–950) for each color
- Derives semantic colors (success, warning, error, info)
- Checks text/background pairs against WCAG AA and AAA contrast
- Previews the palette on real UI components, in light and dark
- Exports Tailwind config / CSS code

- [Landing page](https://huecode.stefaniabarabas.com/): overview and product direction
